content:
Claude Code is a CLI tool from Anthropic that lives in your terminal. 🛠️

No more context-switching or copy-pasting code back and forth to a chat window. It reads your files, runs commands, and debugs with context.

The future of coding is here. #ClaudeCode #AI #SoftwareEngineering

🔥 Tip for Claude Code:

Use `claude run "Add a unit test for this function"` and it will literally create the test file AND run it to verify.

Automated coding with a direct feedback loop. Simply magic. ✨ #Anthropic #Claude #DeveloperExperience

Ever wonder why context switching is the #1 productivity killer? 📉

Claude Code fixes this by being an AI assistant that lives directly in your shell. It's safe-by-design, using a permission-based system for critical commands.

Safe. Fast. Integrated. 🚀 #Productivity #Python #CLI
